required_formats.rule: the Required Format Support tables of the Vulkan 1.2 specification, read by scripts/regen-device-profiles/required_formats.py: m2v_vulkan12_required_formats holds every unconditional entry and m2v_vulkan12_required_formats_if_<feature> the entries a feature this profile requires makes unconditional; `conditional` lists every conditional requirement (at least one table of `any_of` holds in full, on a device supporting `if_feature` when present)

not_represented.text: pname:bufferFeatures must: not support any features for these formats

layer_presentation.rule: the m2v_layer_presentation block states each feature the profile's core version requires without a condition, and each member the product reads of the core device-property structures of its version and of the device-property structures of the extensions it lists, that the profile omits, at the value the product reads, and each format several of its blocks state at the union of their flags, which the product reads (the layer keeps the last block's entry of a format), so that VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_profiles reports the profile as the product reads it

VP_M2V_roadmap_2022.label: Khronos Vulkan Roadmap 2022 profile
VP_M2V_roadmap_2022.description: VP_KHR_roadmap_2022 extracted verbatim from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Profiles/vulkan-sdk-1.4.357.0/profiles/Khronos/VP_KHR_roadmap.json. This roadmap profile is intended to be supported by newer devices shipping in 2022 across mainstream smartphone, tablet, laptops, console and desktop devices.
